a.description: array-like, with ``StringDType``, ``bytes_``, or ``str_`` dtype Input array

sep.description: str or unicode Right-most separator to split each element in array.

output.description: ------- ndarray Output array of ``StringDType``, ``bytes_`` or ``str_`` dtype, depending on input types. The output array will have an extra dimension with 3 elements per input element.
